The dog likes the bear. The dog visits the cow. If something is blue then it is red. If something likes the cow then the cow is big. If the cow needs the cat then the cow likes the cat. If something is blue then it is cold. If something is big and it likes the dog then the dog likes the cow. If something needs the bear and the bear needs the dog then the bear is red. If something likes the bear and it is big then it needs the dog. If something is big then it needs the cat. If the bear is big then the bear likes the dog.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
The cat does not like the dog.

Blue($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: If something is blue then it is red.

Likes(Cat, Dog, False) ::: The cat does not like the dog.
